page.layout: One printed page: one column of running text, with three marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top, page number at top right. Signature and catchword at the foot. The strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Apollo, ego Cephæ, sic apud nos istiusmodi voces
audiantur, ego sum Lutheri, ego Calvini, ego A-
rminii, ego Socini. Quin esto {1} omnis homo mendax,
& verax solus Deus. Non est dignus qui
sit Christi, qui non est unius Christi discipu-
lus. Actum est de fidei Christianæ simplicitate
& sinceritate, postquam itum est in partes: Ne-
que ulla spes est ante restitutum iri pristino vigo-
ri & virori Religionem Christi, quàm diducta tot
fracturis & sciffuris vulnera, fraternæ condescen-
sionis oleo velut malægmate delinita, in eandem
Fidei & Charitatis unitatem coëant & coales-
cant.
XXX. Cavendum porrò Tertiò, ne pravis affectibus
indulgentes, ita nos abduci patiamur in
cujusquam personæ admirationem, ut ex ipsius authoritate toti pendeamus,
{2}Θαυμάζοντες ὠφελείας χάριν[?]. Quibus verbis intendit
digitum Apostolus ad ipsissimum totius mali fontem.
Nempe non aliunde emanavit omnis illa
omnium[?] perversa admiratio quam ex perdita illa
& nimia sua admiratione. Dum quisque propriæ
utilitati studet, infervit honori, gloriæ velificatur;
alios omnes æstimat ex suo commodo: & corrupto
jam hisce affectibus judicio, eos protinus admira-
tur maximè, quos utilitati, honori, gloriæ, aliis-
que suis cupiditatibus minimè adversaturos arbi-
tratur.
Quod ipsum alter etiam Apostolus, quem
ante citavimus clare significat, ubi notat homines sibi {3}κατὰ
XXXI. Cæterùm ut, non obstantibus quæ à
me dicta sunt, sua constet interim & Ecclesiæ Cat-
holicæ, & unicuique viro docto & pio, justa au-
thoritas: Admonendi estis primò, judicio &
piæ Universalis Ecclesiæ, in sacrarum literarum

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Greek in the second and third notes (after {2} and {3}) is faint and only partly legible; the letters marked [?] are best readings. "omnium" after "illa" is partly obscured and marked [?]. The initial "A" of "Apollo" is damaged. The running head "Præleƈtio" uses the ct ligature, written here as ct. The catchword "rum" is the start of the next page's first word, continuing the hyphenated "mo-". Marginal references are transcribed as printed. The left edge strip shows part of the neighbouring page and is excluded.
